subject: general
question: The section on Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution has been adopted from ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__USSR__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fundamental Duties:**

 
 
• The section on **Fundamental Duties** in the** Indian Constitution** has been adopted from **USSR**.
 
• It was added in **Part IV-A and Article 51-A** of the constitution by the **42nd constitutional amendment act, 1976.**
 
• They were based on the Swaran Singh committee's recommendations.
 
• They are **not legally enforceable, unlike fundamental rights.**
 
• Originally there were only** ten fundamental duties**. The **eleventh **was added by the **86th constitutional amendment act, of 2002**.
